doctrine: Execution-backed evidence is the ONLY coverage gate. A construct is covered only when it dispatched/executed in a passing run (O/C/V) or, for the bounded compile-time-form allowlist, was parsed and accepted/generated (A/G). Lexical name-presence in corpus/generator text earns ZERO credit and is reported under `spelled_but_unproven` for diagnostics only. This ledger is the monotonic work queue: the gate FAILS if execution-backed coverage drops below baseline_execution_backed_covered / _fraction, or if any construct not already in `deficit_names` becomes uncovered (the deficit list grows). Regenerate with scripts/language_coverage.py --write-execution-deficit; growth is refused without --allow-deficit-growth so the claim is never walked down silently.
